source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Related command variants were searched and do not replace this coverage.

source_snapshot.master: Master duplicates request definition, omits actual mode/PWM bytes, and accepts completion without thermal or restoration checks.
source_snapshot.comparison: Exact-row DeepSeek and GPT V2 were checked against Master semantics.

historical_reviews.history: Neighboring records and target-specific semantics checked.

original_test_intent: Set a bounded approved manual fan PWM pattern, prove tach response and thermal safety, then restore automatic control.
original_method: Original Master source is retained verbatim; Review adds a safe bounded method.
manual_activity: Thermal owner approves fan mapping, minimum PWM, load state, duration, abort limits and automatic-control recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Run only the bounded approved command
engineer_actions: Approve inputs, limits and recovery; own DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not accepted blindly; missing fields, credential handling and semantic coverage were corrected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Read baseline with 0x30/0x22, apply one approved manual-mode PWM vector, correlate tach/thermal response, then release to auto and verify.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original fields/timing are preserved and absent bytes are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read baseline with 0x30/0x22, apply one approved manual-mode PWM vector, correlate tach/thermal response, then release to auto and verify.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects execution and acceptance only in Review.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reading current fan mode does not satisfy write/control behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Low or wrong fan PWM can overheat components or stall a fan.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tools are allowed only with approved equivalence and explicit disclosure of unverified original-tool/raw-command coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master duplicates request definition, omits actual mode/PWM bytes, and accepts completion without thermal or restoration checks.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core operation is identifiable; target values and approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Adds essential closed-loop thermal protection and recovery to an incomplete OEM write.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fan PWM bytes are actuator commands, not passive configuration. Completion does not show the addressed fans changed, stayed above safe minima, or returned to the platform algorithm; tachometer and temperature evidence plus forced restoration are the acceptance boundary.
